summary: Receives the previous-frame output of a target POP and feeds it back through a POP chain, allowing POP data to be incrementally modified over time.

key_params.name: targetpop
key_params.note: The downstream target POP whose previous output is fed back

key_params.name: preroll
key_params.note: Warm-up amount to run during initialization

key_params.name: donepulse
key_params.note: Immediately move the feedback loop to the done state

key_concepts: Feedback POP retrieves a downstream target POP's data one frame later to create temporal POP feedback loops.
Initialization, start, play, step, pre-roll, and done controls separate setup, warm-up, playback, single-frame stepping, and termination.
Memory limit controls bound how much target POP data can be copied back, which is essential for stable feedback networks.
common_gotchas: The target POP reference is essential; feedback must close around the intended downstream POP.
Feedback loops need validation for bounded values and stable cook health.
Particle POP extends Feedback POP for particle-system workflows and is often a better specialized choice.
